# The rule: every species Kew accepts with a cultivated record, counted as the list counts them (iNaturalist observations marked captive or cultivated, and GBIF living-specimen records of the datasets the dataset rule counts, added together), that scripts/species-list.txt does not hold. Ranked by its records (more first), then its iNaturalist observations (more first), then Kew's name. A species with 3 or more is one whose records reached the list's bar after the list was made. build-dossiers.ts --grow N appends the next N to the list, each with its counts and "queued, added <day>".

# The dataset rule: A GBIF dataset of living-specimen plant records is excluded when its title, keywords, publisher or description uses a word for a genebank (genebank, germplasm, seed bank or seed collection, plant genetic resources, passport data: FAO Genebank Standards 2014), counted when it does not and its title, keywords or publisher names a living collection (botanic garden, arboretum, living collection: BGCI), and otherwise not decided and not counted. (scripts/counted-datasets.txt, excluded-datasets.txt and undecided-datasets.txt list every dataset and why.)
